plan.question: Does 8MiB improve the realistic complete shop test suite compared with16MiB? pgmem as same-machine reference.
plan.upstream_modelcase: bench/modelcase from pinned pgmem MIT source; original70 test cases and expected values retained; explicit MariaDB SQL dialect port
plan.order: rotate three arms each repetition, one process at a time
plan.reader_baseline: one extra Fork shared by50 readers on BOTH engines after source Close;20 private writer Forks. This differs from website20-fork model but equalizes consuming-Snapshot lifecycle.
plan.exit: Five runs each or explicit failed input; all outliers retained. Report full suite elapsed including boot/schema/seed/Snapshot/SQL/Close and process CPU, spans. No new candidate adoption, main or release. No Testcontainers campaign.
